given: Mid-meeting a participant wants to steer Proxy's behavior for the rest of the session only.
when: They type in chat 'Proxy, keep answers shorter and stop posting decision notes.'
then: The preference is parsed, folded into the session-state digest every wake turn reads, applied to later answers (shorter) and to the deterministic decision/action chat-record line (suppressed via the room disable toggle) — never a hard-coded flag and never persisted past the session.
